title: 14_pure_hindi_terms
summary: This agreement says the service will keep charging you each month unless you cancel, and the company can change the rules or shut down your account whenever it wants. It also says they can share your personal data with advertising partners and limit how much they have to pay you if something goes wrong. You should watch out for automatic renewals, the need to cancel a week early, and the fact that they can suspend your account without a refund.
keyPoints: Cancel at least 7 days before the next billing date.
Company can change rules any time without notice.
Your data may be shared with ad and analytics partners.
Account can be suspended or terminated without refund.

risks.clauseQuote: हम किसी भी समय बिना सूचना के नियम बदल सकते हैं और सेवा का निरंतर उपयोग नए नियमों की स्वीकृति माना जाएगा।
risks.explanation: The company can change the rules whenever it wants and you’re considered to have accepted them just by keeping using the service.

risks.clauseQuote: आपकी सदस्यता हर महीने स्वचालित रूप से नवीनीकृत होती है जब तक आप रद्द न करें।
risks.explanation: Your subscription will keep charging you each month unless you actively cancel it.

risks.clauseQuote: कानून द्वारा अनुमत अधिकतम सीमा तक, हमारी कुल देनदारी उस राशि तक सीमित होगी जो आपने पिछले 6 महीनों में चुकाई है।
risks.explanation: If the company messes up, the most they’ll ever pay you is what you’ve spent in the last six months.

risks.clauseQuote: आपका खाता किसी भी समय बिना कारण बताए निलंबित या समाप्त किया जा सकता है और कोई वापसी नहीं होगी।
risks.explanation: They can shut down your account anytime for no reason and you won’t get any money back.

risks.clauseQuote: रद्दीकरण के लिए अगली बिलिंग तिथि से कम से कम 7 दिन पहले अनुरोध करना होगा।
risks.explanation: You have to ask to cancel at least a week before the next billing date, or you’ll be charged again.

risks.clauseQuote: हम आपका व्यक्तिगत डेटा विज्ञापन भागीदारों और विश्लेषण विक्रेताओं के साथ साझा कर सकते हैं।
risks.explanation: Your personal info may be given to advertising and analytics companies, which could use it for ads or profiling.
